# PharmEasy

> > India's leading online pharmacy and healthcare platform offering medicines, health products, diagnostic services, and wellness essentials with up to 60% discounts.

PharmEasy provides a comprehensive e-commerce marketplace for healthcare needs, featuring prescription medicines, over-the-counter products, personal care items, nutritional supplements, medical devices like glucometers, and baby care products. The platform serves as a one-stop digital health solution for Indian consumers.
